en-US.name: Translate Book
en-US.summary: Translate whole PDF, DOCX or EPUB books into a target language. Requires Python 3, pandoc and Calibre ebook-convert; uses many tokens and needs sub-agent support.

zh-CN.name: 整书并行翻译
zh-CN.summary: 把 PDF/DOCX/EPUB 整本书翻成目标语言。需 Python 3、pandoc 与 Calibre ebook-convert；消耗 token 较多，需支持子智能体。

requirements.value: Requires separately installed Python 3, pandoc and Calibre ebook-convert; translation uses many tokens and needs sub-agent support. DesireCore does not install or run these tools. / 需另行安装 Python 3、pandoc 与 Calibre ebook-convert；整书翻译消耗较多 token，并需支持子智能体。DesireCore 不安装或运行这些工具。

Install scope is the upstream repository root, so the DesireCore installer may also copy tests/baselines/standard-alice/standard-alice.epub (10,635,439 bytes), a test fixture not required at runtime. The catalog audit exempts that file from the 1 MiB size budget; this is not an install exclusion. / 安装范围是上游仓库根目录，因此 DesireCore 安装器仍可能一并复制 tests/baselines/standard-alice/standard-alice.epub（10,635,439 字节）。该文件是测试基线，运行时并不需要。目录审核仅豁免其 1 MiB 大小上限，并不等于安装排除。
